info.name: Hotel Booking System
info.description: Run folders 1-7 in order with the Collection Runner. Ids are saved into collection variables as you go. Dates are set to today+10 / today+12 automatically. Each run uses a new random city, so runs don't clash. Folder 8 needs waiting; see its description.

exec: const day = n => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + n); return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10); };

request.description: Also picks a new random city, so every run starts clean.
Deluxe has only 1 room so double booking is easy to see.

item.name: Set special price on check-in day

exec: pm.test('total = 2 rooms x 2 nights x 3000', () => pm.expect(fam.totalPrice).to.eql(12000));

item.name: User 1 books the only Deluxe room

exec: pm.test('amount 2 rooms x 2 nights x 3000', () => pm.expect(b.amount).to.eql(12000));

item.name: 8. Booking expiry (manual)
After hold time: booking is EXPIRED

request.description: Wait hold-minutes + job interval before sending. Tip: start the app with --booking.hold-minutes=0 --booking.expiry-job-interval-ms=2000 and wait ~3s.

item.description: Not part of the normal run: needs waiting. Run this folder alone after starting the app with a short hold time.
